answer: A newcomer forges its identity on a public ledge: it posts a forge bond of 5 POA times the square of its position among identities from one wallet (1st 5, 10th 500 POA) and passes apprenticeship rungs — one useful job per rung, each re-run live by a sparrow auditor drawn at random, staking 2 POA the work was real. The nth identity needs n+2 rungs; a failed rung forfeits the bond, and one sparrow audits one newcomer per epoch, so clones cannot share auditors.
